scope: Native source snapshot validation without loading gameplay code; exact trusted restore remains required.
checks: Synthetic source metadata with unavailable executable validates; exact restore without trusted code still rejects.
Source checksum, complete values, kinds, entity references, component schema binding, saved payloads and reconstructed local transforms are checked.
Real compiled saves validate with unchanged module counts and live snapshot; armed Initialize guard rejects ordinary initialization, while restore bypasses Initialize.
Exact restore retains backend, image, type and complete schema matching and actual fixed-tick continuation.
limitations: Source validation and unchanged exact restore only; not schema migration.
No new GUI, GPU, package activation, or save-performance qualification.
Validation reconstructs and discards bounded native state; it is not allocation-free or cheap metadata inspection.
The caller supplies the trusted source definition and content identity; this low-level API does not independently authenticate that asset closure.
